<?php

class CircuitBreaker {
    private $failureCount = 0;
    private $threshold = 3;
    private $lastFailureTime = 0;
    private $timeout = 30;
    private $state = 'closed'; // closed, open, half-open

    public function getState(): string {
        if ($this->state === 'open' && (time() - $this->lastFailureTime) > $this->timeout) {
            $this->state = 'half-open';
        }
        return $this->state;
    }

    public function recordSuccess(): void {
        $this->failureCount = 0;
        $this->state = 'closed';
    }

    public function recordFailure(): void {
        $this->failureCount++;
        $this->lastFailureTime = time();
        if ($this->failureCount >= $this->threshold) {
            $this->state = 'open';
        }
    }

    public function isAvailable(): bool {
        return $this->getState() !== 'open';
    }
}

class ImageOwnershipResolver {
    private $db;
    private $cache = [];

    public function __construct(PDO $db) {
        $this->db = $db;
    }

    public function resolveOwner(string $imageId): ?int {
        if (isset($this->cache[$imageId])) {
            return $this->cache[$imageId];
        }
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare('SELECT owner_id FROM images WHERE id = :id');
        $stmt->execute([':id' => $imageId]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        if ($row) {
            $this->cache[$imageId] = (int)$row['owner_id'];
            return (int)$row['owner_id'];
        }
        return null;
    }
}

class ImageProcessingPipeline {
    private $circuitBreaker;
    private $ownershipResolver;
    private $currentUserId;
    private $processingQueue = [];

    public function __construct(CircuitBreaker $cb, ImageOwnershipResolver $resolver, int $userId) {
        $this->circuitBreaker = $cb;
        $this->ownershipResolver = $resolver;
        $this->currentUserId = $userId;
    }

    public function enqueueImage(string $imageId, array $transforms): bool {
        $ownerId = $this->ownershipResolver->resolveOwner($imageId);
        if ($ownerId === null) {
            return false;
        }
        $this->processingQueue[] = [
            'image_id' => $imageId,
            'owner_id' => $ownerId,
            'transforms' => $transforms,
            'requester_id' => $this->currentUserId
        ];
        return true;
    }

    public function processQueue(): array {
        $results = [];
        foreach ($this->processingQueue as $job) {
            $results[] = $this->processJob($job);
        }
        $this->processingQueue = [];
        return $results;
    }

    private function processJob(array $job): array {
        if (!$this->circuitBreaker->isAvailable()) {
            return $this->handleCircuitOpen($job);
        }

        try {
            $this->authorizeAccess($job);
            $result = $this->applyTransforms($job['image_id'], $job['transforms']);
            $this->circuitBreaker->recordSuccess();
            return ['status' => 'success', 'image_id' => $job['image_id'], 'result' => $result];
        } catch (\RuntimeException $e) {
            $this->circuitBreaker->recordFailure();
            return ['status' => 'error', 'image_id' => $job['image_id'], 'error' => $e->getMessage()];
        }
    }

    private function handleCircuitOpen(array $job): array {
        // When circuit is open, deny processing entirely - fail secure
        $this->authorizeAccess($job);
        return ['status' => 'unavailable', 'image_id' => $job['image_id'], 'error' => 'Service temporarily unavailable'];
    }

    private function authorizeAccess(array $job): void {
        // Check if requester owns the image or has shared access
        if ($job['owner_id'] !== $job['requester_id']) {
            if (!$this->hasSharedAccess($job['requester_id'], $job['image_id'])) {
                throw new \RuntimeException('Access denied: not image owner');
            }
        }
    }

    private function hasSharedAccess(int $userId, string $imageId): bool {
        // Check sharing permissions in database
        return false; // Simplified: no sharing implemented
    }

    private function getCachedResult(string $imageId): ?string {
        $cachePath = '/tmp/img_cache/' . hash('sha256', $imageId) . '.dat';
        if (file_exists($cachePath) && (time() - filemtime($cachePath)) < 3600) {
            return file_get_contents($cachePath);
        }
        return null;
    }

    private function applyTransforms(string $imageId, array $transforms): string {
        $imagePath = $this->getImagePath($imageId);
        if (!file_exists($imagePath)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Image file not found');
        }
        // Apply transforms and return result path
        $outputDir = '/tmp/img_processed';
        if (!is_dir($outputDir)) {
            mkdir($outputDir, 0700, true);
        }
        $outputPath = $outputDir . '/' . hash('sha256', $imageId . serialize($transforms)) . '.png';
        // Simulated processing
        copy($imagePath, $outputPath);
        @chmod($outputPath, 0600);
        $this->cacheResult($imageId, $outputPath);
        return $outputPath;
    }

    private function getImagePath(string $imageId): string {
        return '/var/app/images/' . hash('sha256', $imageId) . '.png';
    }

    private function cacheResult(string $imageId, string $resultPath): void {
        $cacheDir = '/tmp/img_cache';
        if (!is_dir($cacheDir)) {
            mkdir($cacheDir, 0700, true);
        }
        $cachePath = $cacheDir . '/' . hash('sha256', $imageId) . '.dat';
        file_put_contents($cachePath, $resultPath, LOCK_EX);
        @chmod($cachePath, 0600);
    }
}

// Request handler
function handleProcessRequest(PDO $db): void {
    session_start();
    if (!isset($_SESSION['user_id'])) {
        http_response_code(401);
        echo json_encode(['error' => 'Unauthorized']);
        return;
    }

    $userId = (int)$_SESSION['user_id'];
    $input = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true);

    if (!isset($input['images']) || !is_array($input['images'])) {
        http_response_code(400);
        echo json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid request']);
        return;
    }

    $cb = new CircuitBreaker();
    $resolver = new ImageOwnershipResolver($db);
    $pipeline = new ImageProcessingPipeline($cb, $resolver, $userId);

    foreach ($input['images'] as $item) {
        if (isset($item['id']) && is_string($item['id']) && isset($item['transforms']) && is_array($item['transforms'])) {
            $pipeline->enqueueImage($item['id'], $item['transforms']);
        }
    }

    $results = $pipeline->processQueue();
    echo json_encode(['results' => $results]);
}
